_notes: The 44 WAF post-enablement test cases from MDKPI-7508.
The story has no separate acceptance-criteria field; the 'expected' text IS the criterion.
'automation' classifies each case for THIS framework:
auto    - the runner executes it and produces status-code + screenshot evidence
attack  - the runner executes it, but ONLY in the isolated last step (WAF-38/39)
manual  - cannot be produced from this machine (geo/network origin, email, real devices,
WAF console, or a pre-WAF baseline that does not exist); reported as handoff
Every case appears in the report regardless of class, so nothing is silently dropped.

cases.title: Login page loads
cases.steps: Open the login URL in a fresh browser
cases.expected: Page loads fully; no 403 in Network tab

cases.title: All static assets load
cases.steps: Load a report page; check every JS/CSS/Font/Img request
cases.expected: Every asset returns 200/304; no 403

cases.title: All report pages load
cases.steps: Open every report page in the fixed route list
cases.expected: Each page renders; no 403 on any asset or route

cases.title: Deep link on page refresh
cases.steps: Open a report, reload it (F5)
cases.expected: Same page reloads; not blocked or redirected

cases.title: Direct URL in new tab
cases.steps: Open a deep report URL directly in a new context while logged in
cases.expected: Page opens correctly

cases.title: Browser back/forward
cases.steps: Navigate through 5+ pages, then go back and forward
cases.expected: Navigation works; no blocked requests

cases.title: Lazy-loaded chunks
cases.steps: Navigate to pages that load code on demand; watch console
cases.expected: Chunks load; no 'failed to load chunk' errors

cases.title: All dealership subdomains
cases.steps: Open multiple tenant subdomains
cases.expected: All load the same as before WAF
cases.note: In the dry run this is the single am-gyh tenant; the full run covers all 133 domains.

cases.title: Existing trailing-slash behaviour
cases.steps: Open a page URL with a trailing slash
cases.expected: Behaviour matches pre-WAF (known 404 defect); WAF does not return 403

cases.title: Filters in URL
cases.steps: Apply filters so they appear in the URL, then refresh
cases.expected: Page reloads with filters intact; no 403

cases.title: Long URL
cases.steps: Request a URL with many query params (max filters/dealers/date ranges)
cases.expected: Page loads; not blocked by the URL-size rule

cases.title: Special characters in URL
cases.steps: Filter with values like O'Brien, A&B Motors, 50% off, <test>, --
cases.expected: Page loads; no 403 from the SQLi or XSS rules
cases.note: Benign special chars in query params — distinct from the WAF-38/39 attack payloads.

cases.title: Shared report link
cases.steps: Open a filtered report link in a separate logged-in context
cases.expected: Opens correctly

cases.title: Encoded characters
cases.steps: Request URLs with %20, %27, %3C and similar encoded values
cases.expected: Page loads

cases.title: Login and logout
cases.steps: Log in and log out several times
cases.expected: Works normally

cases.title: Password reset link
cases.steps: Request a reset email and click the link
cases.expected: Reset page opens; token not blocked

cases.title: Invite or activation link
cases.steps: Click a new-user invite link from email
cases.expected: Page opens and the flow completes

cases.title: Links opened via Outlook/Gmail
cases.steps: Open emailed links from Outlook Safe Links and Gmail
cases.expected: Link works; scanners don't trigger a block or use up the token

cases.title: SSO or redirect callbacks (if used)
cases.steps: Complete any login that redirects back with a long query string
cases.expected: Callback page loads
cases.reason: No SSO observed on this portal; verify if SSO exists.

cases.title: Session expiry
cases.steps: Let a session go idle until it expires, then act
cases.expected: Redirected to login properly; no 403 page
cases.note: Simulated by clearing the session token rather than a real idle wait.

cases.title: Access from US
cases.steps: Access via a US IP
cases.expected: Full access

cases.title: Access from Pakistan office
cases.steps: Access from the office network
cases.expected: Full access (team isn't geo-blocked)

cases.title: Access via OpenVPN
cases.steps: Connect through the company VPN
cases.expected: Full access; not flagged as anonymous/VPN

cases.title: Home internet (team)
cases.steps: Access from home ISPs in Karachi
cases.expected: Full access

cases.title: Mobile data
cases.steps: Access from a phone on 4G
cases.expected: Full access

cases.title: Blocked region (if geo rule set)
cases.steps: Access from a country outside the allowed list
cases.expected: Blocked with a clean block page, not a blank screen
cases.reason: Requires egress from a blocked region.

cases.title: Heavy page load
cases.steps: Open the heaviest dashboard / multi-rooftop view
cases.expected: All assets load; no 403 from rate limits

cases.title: Rapid navigation
cases.steps: Click through 20+ pages quickly
cases.expected: No throttling or blocking

cases.title: Many users on one IP
cases.steps: 8-10 team members use the app at once from one office IP
cases.expected: No one gets blocked (simulates a dealership office)
cases.reason: Needs distinct real users; single-IP automation misrepresents this signal.

cases.title: Repeated refresh
cases.steps: Refresh a page 30+ times in a minute
cases.expected: Behaves per the rate-limit rule; any block clears after the window

cases.title: Chrome, Edge, Safari, Firefox
cases.steps: Log in and open reports in each browser
cases.expected: Works in all
cases.note: Automates Chromium, Firefox, WebKit (Safari engine). Real Edge/Safari are manual.

cases.title: Incognito / cleared cache
cases.steps: Open the app with no cache
cases.expected: All assets download without blocks

cases.title: Mobile browsers
cases.steps: Open in Safari (iOS) and Chrome (Android)
cases.expected: Works normally
cases.reason: Requires real mobile devices; emulation is not device testing.

cases.title: Mobile app webviews
cases.steps: Use the app screens that open web pages
cases.expected: Loads normally; not flagged as a bot

cases.title: PDF/print/export features
cases.steps: Use an export that renders the page headlessly
cases.expected: Export completes; headless browser not blocked
cases.note: Runner itself is headless Chromium; a clean sweep is direct evidence headless isn't blocked.

cases.title: Uptime monitoring
cases.steps: Check Grafana / external uptime checks on the frontend URL
cases.expected: Checks still pass; monitor not blocked as a bot

cases.title: Automated test scripts
cases.steps: Run the Selenium/Playwright suite
cases.expected: Runs normally; not blocked by bot rules
cases.note: This runner IS the Playwright automation; a completed clean run is the evidence.

cases.title: Block page appearance
cases.steps: Trigger a block on purpose, e.g. ?q=<script>alert(1)</script>
cases.expected: Clean, branded block page with no technical details exposed

cases.title: Malicious input blocked
cases.steps: Try SQLi, XSS, path traversal (../../etc/passwd) in the URL
cases.expected: Blocked with 403

cases.title: WAF logging
cases.steps: After WAF-38/39, check the WAF logs
cases.expected: Each block logged with rule name, IP, URL and time
cases.reason: Requires WAF console access; captured 403 responses attached for whoever has it.

cases.title: False-positive traceability
cases.steps: For any unexpected 403, find the log entry
cases.expected: Rule ID identified and shared with dev for an exception
cases.reason: Requires WAF console access; runner records every 403 with full headers as input.

cases.title: Page load time
cases.steps: Measure load time on 5 heavy report pages vs the pre-WAF baseline
cases.expected: No noticeable increase (under ~50 ms difference)
cases.reason: No pre-WAF baseline exists in the repo; runner records current load times so a future delta is possible, but the comparison cannot be made now.

cases.title: Caching still works
cases.steps: Load a page twice; check the Network tab
cases.expected: Second load serves assets from cache (304 or cache)

cases.title: Full smoke test
cases.steps: Run the standard regression suite
cases.expected: No new failures compared to pre-WAF
cases.reason: The repo's npm test points at a non-existent Playwright config; 'the suite' here is the .mjs scripts + test:units, run separately.

cases.title: Images and static assets load
cases.steps: On each report module, check every first-party image/js/css/font request and every rendered
cases.expected: No broken images; no 403/404 on any asset
cases.note: Added per full-run request: verify assets across modules after WAF testing.

cases.title: Excel / PDF export
cases.steps: On modules exposing an export/print control, trigger it and validate the downloaded file
cases.expected: Export generates, downloads, is non-empty, and has a valid XLSX/PDF/CSV signature
cases.note: Added per full-run request: verify Excel and PDF exports. Deep layout/content review is manual on the saved file.
